sql.marketo.getLeadStatus: -- Don't like that this uses hardcoded cfgaId select lov.name from flow.contact_custom_field_value ccfv inner join flow.list_of_value lov on lov.id = ccfv.int_value where ccfv.contact_id = :contactId and ccfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id = 399
sql.marketo.getLeadSource: -- Don't like that this uses hardcoded cfgaId select lov.name from flow.contact_custom_field_value ccfv inner join flow.list_of_value lov on lov.id = ccfv.int_value where ccfv.contact_id = :contactId and ccfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id = 395
sql.marketo.getPpsFieldValueByCfgaId: select cfga.id, ppscfv.date_value "dateValue", ppscfv.timestamp_value "timestampValue" from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value ppscfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga.id inner join flow.project_process_step pps on ppscfv.project_process_step_id = pps.id where cfga.id = :cfgaId and pps.project_id = :projectId and pps.main is true
sql.marketo.getStartTimeByProcessStepEventId: select ppse.start_time "startTime" from flow.project_process_step_event ppse inner join flow.project_process_step pps on pps.id = ppse.project_process_step_id where pps.project_id = :projectId and ppse.process_step_event_id = :pseId and ppse.archived is not true and pps.archived is not true order by ppse.date_modified desc limit 1
